content:
In this session on contaminated soils and rocks, dedicated to the perspective of designers, project owners and regulators, the concepts, the existing legal framework, soil assessment and remediation methods, and the opportunities and good practices they should implement will be addressed, and case studies will also be presented, for a deeper understanding of the topic.

Speaking at the session will be Marco Rocha (Brownfield), Sérgio Moreira (Gaiurb), Leonor Santos (BUILT CoLAB) and Sandra Silva (APA), moderated by Vanessa Tavares (BUILT CoLAB).

⏰ 3:00pm – 4:30pm 📌 Register here

This Capacity-Building Action is the first in a cycle of three actions taking place in October, following the protocol BUILT CoLAB established with APA and the Fundo Ambiental under the "Soil Quality Assessment" project.

These events aim to raise awareness among the various stakeholders, from private sector companies to public environmental bodies, about soil quality assessment, risk analysis and sustainable soil remediation processes, thereby contributing to the prevention and combating of soil pollution.

Full information here.
